name: N8N-Automation-Suite
headline: Automated B2B Lead Generation Pipeline
short_description: The Customer-Leads-Generation-Pipeline automates the qualification of sales leads for B2B companies using AI, enhancing efficiency and effectiveness in lead generation. This pipeline is designed to streamline the sales process and improve conversion rates.
author: sollyWolly

sections.overview:
The Customer-Leads-Generation-Pipeline automates lead qualification for B2B sales organizations by combining data enrichment, multi-dimensional scoring, and parallel LLM analysis. The pipeline retrieves organization data from Apollo API, enriches it with business information, traffic metrics from Snowflake, and technology stack data from BuiltWith. Scoring uses embedding-based semantic similarity for business information and tech stacks, while traffic data is ranked against existing customer baselines. Three LLM models—GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Flash, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet—independently qualify leads and recommend salesperson types, with results aggregated and uploaded to Snowflake for sales team use.
Automating lead qualification for B2B sales
Enhancing sales team efficiency
Improving lead conversion rates
Streamlining the sales process

